value.body: A two-year master's degree (also offered as M.Sc Applied Geology, or M.Sc Tech at some institutes) covering mineralogy, petrology, structural geology, stratigraphy, economic geology, hydrogeology and remote sensing, with extended field training. It is the usual qualification for geologist posts in companies and government.

items.note: M.Sc Tech Applied Geology at some institutes runs 3 years

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A B.Sc with Geology. Admission is through IIT JAM (Geology paper) for IITs and some other institutes, CUET-PG for many central universities, or a state or university entrance test.

value.title: At a glance
items: It is the base qualification for the UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Examination.
GATE (Geology & Geophysics) opens M.Tech seats and some PSU posts.
Fieldwork is a large, required part of the course.
